Reflects the withholding of shares of the Issuer's common stock to satisfy tax withholding obligations in connection with the vesting of restricted stock units ("RSUs"). || Includes 320,088 shares issuable upon the vesting and settlement of RSUs granted to the Reporting Person, as well as: (i) 10,393 vested performance restricted stock units ("PRSUs"), which will be
